omissions.reason: French letter cancellation eu in valeurs leaves valrs in the corrected source; it has no English lexical effect. Values is used, and the literal cancellation is explained in translator note 25-142-1.

variant_notes.note: The canceled object le becomes it after specify, following English object placement; the following inserted object keeps its separate variant ID.
Both doubtful French readings de and du have the English prepositional rendering of here; the uncertainty is retained on of and the source alternatives are given in translator note 25-143-1.
Inserted singulier is placed before zero in English, with the same insertion ID and meaning.
